outro.tagline: Write it once. Find it forever.

steps.line: Your team writes everything down. Meeting notes, specs, decisions. Then nobody can find any of it.
Acme Notes keeps it all in one place. Here is how it works.

steps.title: Capture from anywhere
steps.line: Notes come in from meetings, email and chat, without copy and paste.

steps.title: Organised for you
steps.line: Each note is tagged with its project and people, so it lands in the right place.

steps.title: Ask, don't search
steps.line: Ask a question in plain words, and get the answer with a link to the note it came from.

steps.title: Share the decision
steps.line: Send the decision to the people who need it, in the tools they already use.
One workspace, with your data, search and integrations underneath.
Acme Notes. Write it once. Find it forever.
